status: AMENDMENT 4 to the training registration. It adds no prediction and changes no criterion. It fixes the details of rung 3 of the registered ladder (design.ladderIfNothingForms), which the registration left open, so that rung 3 can start now that rung 2 has ended without a formed restart.
instruction: The ladder is registered as an instruction (the user's standing instruction: if training does not produce the pattern for the range of orders considered, extend the range and continue until it is found). This amendment only fixes what the registration left unsaid for rung 3.
condition: Rung 3 is launched only if all 160 restarts of rungs 1 and 2 (rung 1: 4 orders x 10 restarts x 2 ceilings; rung 2: 2 sets x 32 restarts) have ended with no restart at overlap >= 0.9; the launcher checks this itself. The population-64 half (rung 3b) is launched only if every restart of the population-16 half (rung 3a) has also ended with no restart at overlap >= 0.9; the launcher checks this too. If any restart forms, the later part is not run and the ladder is not climbed.

rung3.sets: contiguous orders 0 to N for N = 8, 10, 12, 14, 16, 18 and 20 (seven code sizes; the odd N between them are not run), ceiling 2.0, 16 restarts (0-15) each. Mirror symmetry is kept: no sine terms. N = 20 is the end of the ladder and spans all 21 independent mirror-symmetric ring values.
rung3.rung3a: population 16, 150 generations (the defaults and the pilot arms' setting), one folder data/boundaryHarmonicTraining1888Hold301DoubleStripesInteriorMinus60Minus5Ceiling2HigherOrdersPopulation16/, the seven sizes one after the other in increasing N (--dependency=afterany), so that each size starts from the codes of the sizes below it, which the training script reads from the same folder. 8 GB and 3 h per restart, as the pilot arms.
rung3.rung3b: population 64, 100 generations (arm C's and rung 2's setting), one folder data/boundaryHarmonicTraining1888Hold301DoubleStripesInteriorMinus60Minus5Ceiling2HigherOrdersPopulation64/, the seven sizes one after the other in increasing N as in 3a. 16 GB and 4 h per restart, as rung 2.
rung3.restartsRule: 16 restarts per size is the number the single stripe's higher-order arm and arm C's {0..10} and {0..20} sets used; the registered ladder does not give a number.
rung3.libraryRule: --libraryDirs are the three folders of this target at ceiling 2.0 that exist: arm B's pilot folder (...Ceiling2), rung 1's ceiling-2.0 folder (...Ceiling2Population64) and rung 2's folder (...Ceiling2EvenOrdersPopulation64); rung 3b adds rung 3a's folder. As in every earlier arm the training script's library also holds the stored dial and boundary-harmonic sweeps and every code evaluated in the run's own output folder. It keeps the codes that are cosine series of order <= N (even-only codes qualify), ranks them by their lowest balanced RMS to this target's pattern, reruns the best 16 and scores them properly, and the even-numbered restart r starts from the (r/2)-th best of those. No folder of the face, the single stripe or another ceiling is used, as in Amendments 2 and 3.
rung3.randomStarts: the odd-numbered restarts start from a random allowed code drawn with the generator seed 1000 x N + restart, which depends on N and the restart number only, so rung 3b's random starts are the same draws as rung 3a's; only the population and the library differ, so the two are not independent draws.
rung3.summaries: read with analyzeBoundaryHarmonicTraining11x11.py over the rung's folder or folders (contiguous sizes, no --orders); the tag is Ceiling2HigherOrdersPopulation16 and Ceiling2HigherOrdersCombined (3a and 3b together). Rung 1 and rung 2 are summarised as Amendments 2 and 3 say.
rung3.codesSimulated: at most 7 x 16 x 150 x 16 = 268,800 candidate evaluations in rung 3a and 7 x 16 x 100 x 64 = 716,800 in rung 3b (fewer when the search stops early once every axis of its step is below 1e-4); the actual numbers come from the runs' numEvaluations.

afterRung3: G1 and G2 are read on the finished rung before anything else is launched. If rung 3 forms, the ladder ends. If it does not (including contiguous 0-20, the end of the registered ladder), nothing further is launched without the user: the registered ladder has no rung 4, and breaking mirror symmetry (sine terms) is not allowed.
reportingRules: Every rung is reported with its number of codes simulated. A rung that forms is reported with the route it belongs to. Rungs 1 and 2 are reported as 80 and 64 restarts that did not form.
